text.arabic_uthmani: لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ

words.gloss_range: possessive opening preposition that fronts ownership and rightful attribution

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fused possessive opening with the divine name
delayed relative subject of the ownership predicate

words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) makes possession the first audible relation in the ayah. Because the possessive predicate is fronted before {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}), the created inventory arrives already inside an exclusive ownership frame: what was admitted as created in 31:25 is now cashed as belonging to God. The compact fusion in {{ar:لِلَّهِ}} ({{tr:lillahi}}) also makes owner, ownership, and rightful due land as one opening unit, while the twelve-word ayah compresses possession, totality, self-sufficiency, and praise without needing a supplied missing clause.

topics.headline: fronted possessive restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ownership is grammatically foregrounded before the cosmic contents are named.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the opening as a possessive preposition governing the divine name in a fronted predicate.

topics.headline: compact ownership compression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears ownership, entitlement, and the named possessor compressed into the ayah's first unit.
topics.reason: The local grammar supports possessive force, while the fused proclitic form keeps the relation attached to the divine name.

topics.headline: creation to possession boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 31:26 turn the creation concession of 31:25 into a claim of title and possession.
topics.reason: The first clause is a predicate-first ownership statement and the boundary evidence links it to the prior creation question in 31:25.

words.gloss_range: the divine proper name as genitive possessor in the opening ownership predicate
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with worship-directed deity and classical derivational pressures; locally the proper name identifies the possessor

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: possessive preposition governing the divine name

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allahi}}) is governed by the possessive {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}), so the named God appears first as possessor, not merely as a topic. The proper name keeps the owner determinate, while the worship-directed deity and bewildering-transcendence pressures around {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) are narrowed to the local role: the possessor of the cosmic domain is the singular divine referent, not a generic deity class. The name also stands in the familiar God-heavens and God-earth association, with same-surah anchors around 31:16, 31:18, 31:20, 31:25, 31:27, and 31:34, before returning in word 9 with a new case to link what belongs to God with what God is.

topics.headline: genitive named possessor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the owner is the definite divine name placed before the owned domain.
topics.reason: The divine name is genitive under the possessive preposition and is part of the fronted predicate.

topics.headline: divine-name root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses that the possessor is not an abstract owner but the worship-directed divine referent.
topics.reason: The derivational and devotional pressures are meaningful, but the local surface is the proper divine name rather than a common noun or a full etymological argument.

topics.headline: cosmic pairing and reprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the divine name from cosmic possession into the later attribute clause.
topics.reason: The same divine name is locally repeated, and the contextual profiles support its standard association with the heavens-earth domain.

topics.headline: fused name form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the possessive relation and named possessor compressed into one recited token.
topics.reason: The surface form joins the proclitic preposition to the divine proper name.

topics.headline: prior creation extension
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the word connect the previous creation admission in 31:25 to the present ownership-and-identity argument.
topics.reason: The same divine referent carries the sequence from the 31:25 creation question into 31:26.

words.gloss_range: broad relative pronoun supplying the delayed subject of the ownership predicate

supporting_anchors.display: {{ar:مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:ma fi l-samawati wa-l-ardi}})
supporting_anchors.gloss_range: totalizing relative phrase covering what is in the heavens and earth

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) supplies the delayed subject after ownership has already been assigned to God. Its breadth matters: it gathers rational beings and non-rational things, including angels, humans, animals, minerals, processes, and phenomena, into one owned field without sorting them into classes. In the familiar {{ar:مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:ma fi l-samawati wa-l-ardi}}) formula, totality expands only after the restrictive predicate has set the frame.

topics.headline: delayed relative subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the owned totality unfolds after exclusive ownership is already established.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the subject of the fronted possessive predicate.

topics.headline: all-category scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the wording avoids a class limit and can include every kind of created content.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is compatible with broad rational and non-rational coverage inside the prepositional domain phrase.

topics.headline: totality formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as a standard meristic way to speak of all created existence.
topics.reason: The local phrase uses the familiar heavens-earth containment formula.

words.gloss_range: containment preposition marking heavens and earth as the domain within which the owned contents are located
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fi}}) makes the cosmic nouns containers or domains for the owned contents. The ayah does not say merely what comes from the heavens and earth or what rests on their surface; it gathers whatever is within those realms and under their domain. This preposition also holds the phrase together until the conjunction adds the earth under the same containment frame.

topics.headline: containment domain marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ownership is stated over contents within cosmic domains, not over detached objects.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the heavenly noun and establishes the locative phrase in the relative clause.

topics.headline: preposition choice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why containment and domain membership are more exact than source or surface-contact wording.
topics.reason: The selected preposition licenses containment, while other relations such as source or surface contact are not the local construction.

topics.headline: phrase completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the locative phrase as a single unit completed by the coordinated earth noun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence places both cosmic nouns under the same prepositional domain through coordination.

words.gloss_range: definite plural upper realms governed by the containment preposition
words.root_gloss_range: height and elevation field; locally the definite plural names the recognized layered upper cosmic domain

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: containment preposition governing the heavenly domain
coordinated lower cosmic domain

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-samawati}}) is the first contained domain, genitive under {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fi}}). Its definite plural form makes the upper realm known and layered, not a single visible sky, while the root image of height gives the merism its vertical upper pole. Paired with {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ardi}}), it works as part of the standard heavens-earth totality; their shared definite onset and genitive closure make the pair audible as one coordinated unit, while spatial totality in the first half mirrors the attribute pair in the second. The word also gathers nearby Luqman sky references from 31:10, 31:16, 31:20, 31:25, and 31:29 into the ownership claim.

topics.headline: governed definite heavens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heavens are a governed, recognized domain within the ownership phrase.
topics.reason: The noun is definite plural and genitive under the preceding preposition.

topics.headline: layered height domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the upper realm as elevated and plural-layered while avoiding an unsupported claim about exact cosmological count.
topics.reason: The root and plural form support height and multiplicity, but the local wording does not require a precise model beyond layered upper realms.

topics.headline: plural singular merism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the plural heavens and singular earth forming a single totalizing pair.
topics.reason: The local coordination and contextual pairing evidence support the heavens-earth merism.

topics.headline: surah cosmic thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this line summarize a Luqman cosmic thread already active at 31:10, 31:16, 31:20, 31:25, and 31:29.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL row gives concrete same-surah references, and the local word belongs to the same cosmic domain.

topics.headline: paired cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two cosmic nouns as one coordinated unit rather than separate inventory items.
topics.reason: The collocation and sound-shape rows both support the local pair functioning as a unified totality marker.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction attaching the earth to the same governed cosmic domain phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: shared containment preposition for the coordinated domains
bound conjunction with the earth noun

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not open a second assertion; it coordinates the earth into the same governed phrase under {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fi}}). The conjunction makes the two domains complete each other as a merism, while the bound onset of {{ar:وَٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:wa-l-ardi}}) makes that attachment audible. Across the boundary from 31:25, the same heavens-earth pair shifts from created object to possessed domain.

topics.headline: same governed coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earth is added under the same ownership and containment frame as the heavens.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the earth noun as coordinated to the heavens under the same preposition.

topics.headline: paired domain accompaniment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the earth travel with the heavens as one two-domain formula.
topics.reason: The conjunction is bound to the earth noun and coordinates it with the preceding cosmic noun.

topics.headline: creation to possession pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same cosmic pair from 31:25 repredicated as God's possession in 31:26.
topics.reason: The boundary row connects the prior creation question with the present ownership statement.

words.gloss_range: definite singular earth as the lower cosmic domain coordinated under the same containment phrase
words.root_gloss_range: ground, land, lower spread, firmness, and terrestrial domain; locally narrowed to the cosmic earth rather than a political territory

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: coordinated upper cosmic domain

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ardi}}) inherits the genitive containment frame from {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-samawati}}), so it is not a new clause but the lower half of the same owned domain. Its definite singular form treats all terrestrial spread as one known earth-domain, narrowed here away from political land or local territory. The root pressure of spread, lowness, and firmness gives the merism its grounded lower pole, and its recurrence across 31:20, 31:25, and 31:27 makes 31:26 a hinge in the surrounding cosmic argument.

topics.headline: inherited governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earth remains inside the same prepositional ownership phrase as the heavens.
topics.reason: The noun is coordinated to the genitive heavens and shares the prepositional frame.

topics.headline: known cosmic earth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads the word as the recognized lower cosmic domain, not as a bounded land or jurisdiction.
topics.reason: The heavens-earth merism selects the cosmic lower realm from the broader land and territory range.

topics.headline: grounded spread substrate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the earth as the spread-out firm lower pole beneath the elevated heavens.
topics.reason: The root and derivative images support spread and firmness, while local syntax keeps the word as a cosmic domain noun.

topics.headline: singular mass domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the asymmetry: plural heavens above, singular collective earth below.
topics.reason: The local phrase coordinates a plural upper noun with a singular lower noun in one totality formula.

topics.headline: cosmic totality thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees earth as the lower half of a recurring totality frame spanning 31:20, 31:25, 31:26, and 31:27.
topics.reason: The collocation evidence marks the heavens-earth pair as a totality marker, and the row gives concrete nearby references.

words.gloss_range: emphatic annulment particle opening the second nominal clause and governing its subject

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accusative subject governed by the emphatic particle
paired final predicates of the emphatic clause

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) pivots the ayah from what belongs to God into what God is. Its force is both syntactic and rhetorical: it governs {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allaha}}) as the accusative subject of the clause while asserting the predicate pair through {{ar:ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ}} ({{tr:al-ghaniyyu al-hamidu}}). After the unresolved concession and adversative turn of 31:25, this particle supplies the firm explanatory declaration, and the whole verbless architecture stacks assertion, separation, and definite predicates as stable identity rather than narrated action.

topics.headline: case restructuring emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that emphasis is carried by a particle that also restructures the clause grammatically.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the particle as opening an emphatic clause and governing its noun.

topics.headline: scope over attribute pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second half as asserted identification rather than a loose afterthought to ownership.
topics.reason: The particle opens the clause whose predicates are the two final divine attributes.

topics.headline: boundary answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the particle answer the tension left by the prior concession in 31:25.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL boundary rows connect the emphatic declaration to the preceding rhetorical rupture in 31:25.

topics.headline: verbless emphatic architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's stable nominal architecture rather than reading it as an event report.
topics.reason: Both clauses are nominal, and the second stacks emphasis through the particle, separation pronoun, and definite predicates.

words.gloss_range: the repeated divine proper name as accusative subject of the emphatic identity clause
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with worship and transcendence pressures; locally the proper name anchors the predicate pair to the same possessor

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic particle governing the repeated divine name
earlier genitive possessor occurrence of the same name
first predicate attached to the repeated divine name
second predicate attached to the repeated divine name

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allaha}}) repeats the same divine name from the opening, now as the accusative subject governed by {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}). The case shift from {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allahi}}) to {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allaha}}) tracks the ayah's argument: the one named as possessor is now identified through the predicates. The worship and bewilderment pressures around {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) remain narrowed to this proper-name role, while the syntax attaches {{ar:ٱلْغَنِىُّ}} ({{tr:al-ghaniyyu}}) and {{ar:ٱلْحَمِيدُ}} ({{tr:al-hamidu}}) to that same named referent as standing attributes, not ordinary wealth or timed action.

topics.headline: emphatic subject identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated divine name is now the governed subject of an identity claim.
topics.reason: The word is accusative as the noun of the emphatic particle and is completed by the predicate pair.

topics.headline: proper name attribute anchor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees worship-directed divine-name pressure attach to the identity clause without replacing the proper-name parse.
topics.reason: The root-family pressure is meaningful, but the local form is still the proper divine name anchoring predicates.

topics.headline: case-shifted reprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same name moving from possessor to emphatic subject.
topics.reason: The two occurrences of the divine name have different cases and roles across the two clauses.

topics.headline: timeless attribute link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees self-sufficiency and praiseworthiness as standing predicates of the named owner, not as ordinary wealth or timed actions.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and nominal-clause evidence support reading the final attributes as stable divine predicates.

words.gloss_range: third-person masculine singular separation pronoun marking predicate identification and restriction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: named referent of the separation pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) is the separation pronoun between {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allaha}}) and the predicate pair. It prevents the following attribute from sounding like a loose adjective and makes the claim land as identification: God, He, is the Self-Sufficient and Praiseworthy. Its masculine singular reference also keeps the predicates tied to the named God rather than to the surrounding cosmic plural, and the short pronoun creates a rhythmic reset before the final twin attributes.

topics.headline: separation pronoun identification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun turns the attributes into a focused identity claim, not a loose description.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a separation pronoun between the subject and predicate.

topics.headline: referent lock
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the predicates attach to the named God rather than to the cosmic contents.
topics.reason: The pronoun is masculine singular and refers back to the divine name.

topics.headline: delayed restrictive landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the predicate delayed until after a stacked emphatic frame.
topics.reason: The sequence stacks the emphatic particle, named subject, separation pronoun, and definite predicates.

topics.headline: rhythmic reset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a brief pause-like reset before the longer final attributes.
topics.reason: The sound row is compatible with the short pronoun's position before the two longer definite predicates.

words.gloss_range: definite first predicate naming God's intrinsic self-sufficiency and freedom from need
words.root_gloss_range: wealth, sufficiency, freedom from need, and related song or melody branch; locally the definite faʿil predicate selects needlessness and self-sufficiency

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second member of the paired divine attributes

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغَنِىُّ}} ({{tr:al-ghaniyyu}}) lands as the first predicate after the separation pronoun, not as a mere adjective. Its definiteness and faʿil shape present God as the Self-Sufficient One, with sufficiency as a stable attribute rather than a temporary condition or an act of making another sufficient. The broader {{ar:غ ن ي}} ({{tr:gh-n-y}}) family includes wealth, needlessness, human self-claim, and even song, but the local ownership frame narrows the live sense to real divine freedom from need; beside {{ar:ٱلْحَمِيدُ}} ({{tr:al-hamidu}}), it joins a recurring attribute pair seen at 22:64, 35:15, 57:24, and 60:6, with 31:12 as a same-surah return in a different setting.

topics.headline: definite self-sufficient predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word identifies God as the unique self-sufficient one rather than describing ordinary richness.
topics.reason: The word is definite, nominative, and licensed as the first predicate of the emphatic clause.

topics.headline: needlessness over wealth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ownership frame select freedom from need rather than ordinary wealth or human self-sufficiency claims.
topics.reason: The root range is broad, but total ownership and divine predication select ontological self-sufficiency.

topics.headline: song branch subordinated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the praise-sound association as background pressure while keeping needlessness as the selected local branch.
topics.reason: The evidence allows the song or melody branch in the wider family, but the local surface and predicate frame select self-sufficiency.

topics.headline: stable faʿil attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees sufficiency as God's own durable attribute, not an event of enriching or sufficing someone else.
topics.reason: The local form is a definite faʿil adjective, not a Form IV causative verb.

topics.headline: ghaniyy hamid pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees self-sufficiency and praiseworthiness as a paired divine-name cluster rather than isolated traits.
topics.reason: The rows give recurring divine-attribute examples at 22:64, 35:15, 57:24, and 60:6, and a same-surah return at 31:12.

topics.headline: sound tightening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the compact doubled ending prepare the matched final attribute.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local to the surface form and its position before the matching predicate.

words.gloss_range: definite second predicate naming intrinsic praiseworthiness as the final seal of the clause
words.root_gloss_range: praise, commendation, and praiseworthiness; locally the faʿil predicate selects intrinsic worthiness of praise rather than the act or reception of praise

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first member of the paired final predicates
nearby praise noun from 31:25 echoed by the final attribute
opening ownership phrase echoed by the closing praise-root attribute

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَمِيدُ}} ({{tr:al-hamidu}}) completes the same predicate frame as {{ar:ٱلْغَنِىُّ}} ({{tr:al-ghaniyyu}}), so the final word is not an ornamental add-on. Its definite faʿil form names intrinsic praiseworthiness: God is worthy of praise whether or not creation actually praises Him, and this differs from gratitude for a particular benefit, repeated praising, or a passive record of being praised. The ending also answers 31:25, where {{ar:ٱلْحَمْدُ}} ({{tr:al-hamdu}}) is uttered as praise, by naming in 31:26 the One whose attribute grounds that praise; the opening {{ar:لِلَّهِ}} ({{tr:lillahi}}) and closing {{ar:ٱلْحَمِيدُ}} ({{tr:al-hamidu}}) redistribute the praise formula associated with 1:2 across the ayah. Because {{ar:ٱلْغَنِىُّ}} ({{tr:al-ghaniyyu}}) comes first, self-sufficiency grounds generosity and makes praiseworthiness the logical second predicate, and the matched long-vowel closure lets the paired final predicates turn what God has into what God is.

topics.headline: definite second predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that praiseworthiness is the second predicate in the same identity clause, not a loose closing epithet.
topics.reason: The word is definite, nominative, and attached as a second predicate of the emphatic clause.

topics.headline: intrinsic praiseworthiness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees praise grounded in God's inherent excellence rather than in received praise or return-benefit.
topics.reason: The semantic rows distinguish intrinsic praiseworthiness from gratitude and from actually being praised; the local predicate selects the intrinsic attribute.

topics.headline: praise field transition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the praise utterance of 31:25 answer as a divine attribute in 31:26.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give the concrete 31:25 to 31:26 echo between praise as utterance and praiseworthiness as attribute.

topics.headline: twin faʿil attribute pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears sufficiency and praiseworthiness intensified together as co-stable attributes.
topics.reason: Both final predicates share the faʿil adjective shape and nominative predicate frame.

topics.headline: form contrast not action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah names the one worthy of praise rather than repeated praising or a passive state of being praised.
topics.reason: The local form is the faʿil predicate, not a Form II action or passive participle.

topics.headline: ghaniyy hamid closing cluster
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final pair as the explanatory ground of the ownership claim.
topics.reason: The recurrent pair, shared morphology, and closing position all support reading the ending as an attribute seal.

topics.headline: lillahi hamid frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah framed from ownership at the start to praiseworthiness at the end, with an echo of the praise formula at 1:2.
topics.reason: The rows connect the opening ownership phrase and closing praise-root attribute, including the concrete 1:2 formulaic echo.

topics.headline: dominion to identity argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the ayah's movement from what God owns to why God needs nothing and is worthy of praise.
topics.reason: The structure moves from ownership over the cosmic domain to the paired predicates of self-sufficiency and praiseworthiness.

topics.headline: final cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears praiseworthiness as the ayah's last audible takeaway after the matched long-vowel predicate pair.
topics.reason: The word is final, shares the predicate cadence with the preceding attribute, and closes the clause.

topics.headline: praise speech act grounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the previous command to praise grounded in God's own praiseworthiness rather than in a rhetorical response alone.
topics.reason: The boundary row links the praise speech-act in 31:25 with the divine attribute at the end of 31:26.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The preposed divine dative governs an unrestricted relative across the paired upper and lower domains, followed by an emphatic independent pronoun and two predicates.
baseline_models.mechanism: The spatial merism makes possession exhaustive, while independence from need prevents that possession from being acquisition and praiseworthiness prevents it from being inert abundance.

activation_trace.role: Upper, overshadowing space supplies the upper pole of the exhaustive domain.
The lower world opposite the sky supplies the complementary pole of the exhaustive domain.
Independence from need makes total possession non-acquisitive and one-directional.
Abundant commendable qualities make praise intrinsic to the possessor rather than supplied by the possessions.

changed_reading.before: A statement that the contents of heaven and earth are divine property, followed by two honorifics.
changed_reading.after: Everything depends on one possessor who cannot be enriched by the totality and whose worth is not conferred by it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two final predicates are read as a functional pair rather than as unrelated epithets.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sufficiency branch permits a positive reading of independence: not merely needing nothing, but being adequate for others; experienced adequacy then becomes the ground of praise.

activation_trace.role: Sufficing and benefiting another turns negative non-need into outward adequacy.
Being found satisfactory after experience makes praise recognition of delivered sufficiency.

changed_reading.before: The independent one is rich and is praised.
changed_reading.after: The independent one is also the one who suffices others, so praise registers benefit without filling any divine lack.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier exact reprise places the final predicates after gratitude that benefits its own subject and ingratitude that covers benefit. The pair therefore defines a nonreciprocal economy: recognition changes the receiver, not the giver's resources or worth.

activation_trace.role: Independence from need anchors the focus claim that no human response supplies a lack.
Praise for good action anchors the focus predicate as deserved rather than manufactured by the praiser.
Recognition of benefit and praise of the benefactor make gratitude a response to received good.
The thing's own self confines gratitude's gain to the grateful subject.
Covering a benefit models ingratitude as failed recognition rather than loss to the giver.
The repeated independence predicate explicitly seals the gratitude and ingratitude alternatives.
The repeated praise predicate keeps worth intact across both human responses.

structural_cues: 31:12 repeats both focus predicates after opposed gratitude and ingratitude conditionals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-benefiting gratitude, covered benefit, and the exact repeated pair; I infer that praise and sufficiency are nonreciprocal, while the live alternative is that the pair merely closes the warning.

changed_reading.before: Divine independence and praiseworthiness are general qualities following universal possession.
changed_reading.after: Neither gratitude nor refusal alters the possessor: gratitude realizes benefit in the creature, while praise remains deserved even when benefit is covered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's maximal spatial range is stress-tested by a minimally weighted seed enclosed behind hard matter. Its being brought forth converts universal possession from broad coverage into exact addressability across scale, concealment, and location.

activation_trace.role: The upper domain anchors one extreme of the focus's spatial totality.
The lower domain anchors the opposite extreme of the focus's spatial totality.
Measured weight makes the tiny object exact rather than merely rhetorically small.
A seed supplies the compact material object tracked through the location test.
A hard massive rock supplies a resistant enclosure that does not block retrieval.
The repeated upper domain relocates the tiny object into one pole of the focus merism.
The repeated lower domain completes the focus merism inside the retrieval test.
Coming and arrival give the hidden object's recovery a directional endpoint.
Fineness, smallness, and hiddenness identify the scale at which control remains operative.
Knowledge of an affair's interior supplies epistemic access through the material enclosure.

structural_cues: 31:16 nests a minimum-scale object in a rock or either member of the focus's heaven-earth pair, then gives it a retrieval verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured seed, enclosure, both focus domains, bringing, subtlety, and inward knowledge; I infer that possession entails addressability and retrieval, while a live alternative is that the sequence concerns knowledge alone.

changed_reading.before: Universal possession means that no region lies outside the divine domain.
changed_reading.after: Universal possession is resolution-sensitive: no object is too small, enclosed, high, or low to be located and brought forth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same upper-lower totality is directed toward human use and completed as both disclosed and concealed benefit. Paired with the focus's sufficiency branch, possession reads as an asymmetrical source of usability rather than hoarding.

activation_trace.role: Sufficing others supplies the focus-side bridge from possession to provision.
Directing a thing toward a purpose turns the cosmic domain into usable service.
The upper domain repeats the first half of the focus totality under directed use.
The lower domain repeats the second half of the focus totality under directed use.
Completion and fullness make provision comprehensive rather than occasional.
Good condition and benefit identify what the directed totality delivers to creatures.
Disclosure and emergence supply the perceptible layer of benefit.
Hidden interiority supplies the unperceived layer, preventing benefit from being reduced to what is visible.

structural_cues: 31:20 repeats the focus's unrestricted upper-lower construction, adds a beneficiary, then polarizes benefits as outward and inward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful direction, completed benefit, and visible-hidden coverage; I infer that the focus possession is generative provision, while a live alternative is that these details only prove dominion.

changed_reading.before: Everything is owned by the independent possessor.
changed_reading.after: The possessor's independence coexists with complete outward provision: all-domain ownership is organized into benefit without reciprocal need.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding question elicits a spoken concession about who originated the paired domains, then commands that concession to become praise while diagnosing incomplete understanding. The focus verse completes the unmade inference from creator to possessor and from answer to evaluative recognition.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies the causal ground behind the conceded answer.
The upper domain carries the exact first member of the focus merism into the question.
The lower domain carries the exact second member of the focus merism into the question.
Voiced speech supplies both the respondents' concession and the command that redirects it.
Praise for good action converts a correct creator-answer into its required evaluation.
Failure of disclosure to the knower explains why the verbal concession has not become a changed stance.
The focus predicate stabilizes the commanded praise as an enduring quality.

structural_cues: 31:25 immediately precedes the focus and carries over the same domain pair, divine name, and praise root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies question, creator concession, praise command, and incomplete knowledge; I read 31:26 as the inferential completion of that sequence, while it may also function as an independent restatement.

changed_reading.before: The focus independently asserts ownership and praiseworthiness.
changed_reading.after: The focus exposes the consequence missing from a merely correct answer: conceded origination should become recognition of total dependence and deserved praise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse converts terrestrial growth and multiple seas into writing equipment and supply, then lets the material system run out while divine words do not. This activates independence as inexhaustibility not only of resources but of expression and determination.

activation_trace.role: Freedom from need anchors the focus-side claim of non-depletion.
The lower world becomes the finite material base consumed by the analogy.
A prepared writing reed turns earthly material into an instrument of inscription.
Vast abundant water supplies the enormous but still finite writing medium.
Ink replenishing a pen makes the material analogy operational rather than merely quantitative.
Cessation and exhaustion define the limit that applies to the apparatus but not to divine words.
Meaning-bearing words name the non-material output that exceeds every material supply.

structural_cues: 31:27 immediately follows the focus with a counterfactual writing analogy in which created materials exhaust before divine words.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finite writing instruments, serial replenishment, exhaustion, and unexhausted words; I connect that non-depletion to the adjacent independence predicate, while the live alternative is that the analogy measures words without glossing that predicate.

changed_reading.before: Independence means that the possessor does not need the possessed world.
changed_reading.after: Even if the possessed world is converted into expressive supply, it is the supply that depletes; the divine source remains semantically inexhaustible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later conclusion contrasts stable reality with invoked alternatives that lose truth and stability, then names divine ascendancy. Universal belonging in the focus therefore reads as ontological dependence: rival claims cannot establish an independent domain.

activation_trace.role: Independence from need anchors the sole non-derivative side of the relation.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the positive ontological pole.
Calling and verbal attraction mark the rival relation as an invoked claim.
Otherness identifies the alleged alternative outside the divine claim.
Loss of truth and stability denies the alternative any durable independent standing.
Ascendant mastery supplies the governing relation over every derivative domain.

structural_cues: 31:30 presents itself as a conclusion from the preceding cosmic control sequence and repeats the focus's emphatic pronoun pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stable reality, failed alternatives, and ascendancy; I infer that the focus's possession names derivative existence, while a live alternative keeps 31:30 as a separate anti-idolatry conclusion.

changed_reading.before: All entities fall under one owner's legal or sovereign claim.
changed_reading.after: All entities have only derivative standing; the one independent possessor is not one claimant among rivals because rival independence fails to stabilize.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning explicitly cancels substitution in both directions across the strongest generative bond and reduces the transferable remainder to not even one thing. This refracts the focus's sufficiency branch: creaturely relations cannot make one party sufficient for another at the decisive limit.

activation_trace.role: Sufficing and standing in for another provide the focus-side capacity tested by the warning.
One thing taking another's place states the exact substitution that both reciprocal clauses negate.
Descent and offspring identify the intimate bond whose capacity to substitute nevertheless fails.
A knowable thing supplies the minimal residue, and its negation makes the failure total.

structural_cues: 31:33 mirrors parent and child in reciprocal clauses and closes the second with an indefinite minimal object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitution, kinship, and its total negation; I contrast that failed creaturely sufficiency with the focus predicate, while the live alternative is to keep the warning strictly juridical.

changed_reading.before: The independent one has no need of creatures.
changed_reading.after: Divine sufficiency is non-substitutable, while even the strongest creaturely bond cannot transfer responsibility or make one self sufficient for another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close places decisive knowledge in divine presence while each self lacks knowledge of tomorrow's acquisition and even the earth of its own death. Universal possession expands from spatial inclusion into epistemic and temporal enclosure: a creature occupies the domain without owning its next gain or endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Independence from need anchors the contrast with creatures dependent on an unknown future.
Near presence locates decisive knowledge with God rather than with the acting self.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the positive side of the final knowledge asymmetry.
Practical knowing is twice negated for the creature, marking the boundary of self-command.
The self as the thing itself makes the ignorance personal rather than merely collective.
Seeking and obtaining benefit names the next gain that the self cannot pre-possess in knowledge.
The lower domain returns as an unknown specific location inside the focus's universally possessed whole.
Loss of life supplies the creature's terminal event, known neither in place nor by self-command.

structural_cues: 31:34 repeats that no self knows, pairs tomorrow's acquisition with the earth of death, and closes with divine knowing and interior expertise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine presence of knowledge and creaturely ignorance of gain and death-place; I infer that possession includes temporal and epistemic command, while a live alternative treats the close as a knowledge list only.

changed_reading.before: All places in the upper and lower worlds belong to God.
changed_reading.after: A creature's next benefit and final point within the lower world remain outside its own possession in knowledge; spatial belonging includes the unowned future endpoint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant split mapping from the heaven root to the marking root. It remains anchored by the focus's upper domain, the lower fertile surface, and the packet's rain-marking bridge; downstream prose should present it as a latent graphic analogy, not as the lexical meaning of the focus noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins the upper domain to the lower world under one preposed relation and closes with praiseworthiness.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark recasts the upper domain as a readable trace rather than only a location.
Soft fertile ground supplies the receiving surface on which a trace can become growth.
First rain marking land through vegetation supplies a material bridge from upper source to inscribed lower surface.
Being found praiseworthy through experience lets the world's marks function as discoverable evidence.

changed_reading.before: Heavens and earth are coordinate regions in a total inventory.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the upper-lower whole is also a marked surface: provision leaves readable traces through which praiseworthiness is found.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a naming branch activated by the appointed-term wording is fed back into the focus's heaven root. It remains anchored by the repeated cosmic domain and its sun-moon sequence; downstream prose should call it a temporal activation of possession, not redefine the heavens as a name.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: What lies in the focus's upper domain is later rendered as interpenetrating periods and running celestial bodies.

activation_trace.role: The upper overshadowing domain anchors the celestial contents whose motion is later specified.
Mutual entry makes night and day dynamic interpenetrating phases rather than fixed containers.
Night's darkness supplies one alternating temporal phase.
Day's opening by light supplies the reciprocal temporal phase.
Continuous running turns celestial possession into maintained motion.
A fixed temporal limit bounds each maintained circuit.
Naming and designation make the limit specified rather than anonymous.

changed_reading.before: The upper world is a static part of the possessed totality.
changed_reading.after: The upper world is a scheduled system of interlocking phases and continuously run bodies, each held to a specified endpoint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the storm scene does not lexically explain the focus's independence predicate; it activates it by contrast. It remains anchored in that predicate and in a mechanism of disturbance, exclusive allegiance, rescue, and knowing denial; downstream prose should state it as a contrastive disclosure of creaturely dependence, not a direct gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's independence and sufficing capacity are contrasted with creatures whose apparent autonomy collapses under an enclosing disturbance.

activation_trace.role: Capacity to suffice others anchors the rescue side of the contrast.
Intermixed agitation destroys the travelers' ordinary sense of stable control.
An overhead canopy turns the disturbance into an enclosing upper threat.
Exclusive separation from partnership strips allegiance down to a single dependence.
Obedient yielding gives the exposed dependence a relational form.
Release by separation supplies the rescue that the creature could not secure independently.
Denial despite knowledge explains how revealed dependence can be covered again after safety.

changed_reading.before: Divine independence is an abstract contrast to the owned universe.
changed_reading.after: A crisis temporarily discloses the contrast experientially: creatures cannot suffice themselves, exclusive dependence emerges, and rescue can later be knowingly denied.

strongest_changes: The 31:12 reprise turns independence and praise into a nonreciprocal gratitude economy.
The 31:16 scale-and-enclosure test turns spatial totality into exact retrievability.
The 31:27 writing analogy turns material possession into a contrast between exhaustible apparatus and inexhaustible expression.
The 31:33 substitution failure gives the sufficiency branch a relational contrast unavailable in the focus alone.
The 31:34 close extends possession into the creature's epistemically unowned future and death-place.
summary.what_was_special: The focus did not settle into one ownership theme. Repetition and branch activation made it simultaneously nonreciprocal, provisioning, resolution-sensitive, ontological, temporally administered, and open to two contained material analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: The marked-surface reading depends on a deliberately form-distant split-root mapping and should remain exploratory.
The link from unexhausted words in 31:27 to the independence predicate is strongly adjacent but reader-supplied.
The non-substitution contrast in 31:33 may be juridical without intending a direct expansion of the sufficiency predicate.
The crisis reading reveals creaturely dependence by contrast and is not a lexical explanation of the focus adjective.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Comprehensive belonging establishes asymmetrical sufficiency.** **س م و B004** and **ء ر ض B001** span upper cover and lower ground; **غ ن ي B001–B002** is self-sufficiency and the capacity to suffice or replace. The fronted divine possession of the merism precedes emphatic self-sufficiency. I infer that the owner of the total field cannot depend on any item inside it, while every item can be supplied from that field. *Al-Ghanī* reads relationally as the asymmetry generated by comprehensive belonging.
2. **Praise does not wait for human acknowledgment.** **ح م د B003** is the one praiseworthy through many good traits and **B002** being found satisfactory. The previous ayah showed people stating the creator’s name without knowledge; here **ح م د** is predicated without a human praising verb. I infer that praiseworthiness is intrinsic and discoverable, not conferred. The pairing with **غ ن ي B001** makes independence from praise part of what warrants praise.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 31:27 immediately tested sufficiency against an imagined depletion apparatus: every tree-pen and serial sea fails before divine words do. That material failure made *al-Ghanī* read not as static wealth but as sourcehood untouched by total consumption of created media.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Ownership without acquisitive need.** Lexical evidence: `غ ن ي B001` is self-sufficiency and freedom from need, and `ح م د B001` is praise for praiseworthy action and benefaction. Structural cue: total possession is followed not by increase or extraction but by emphatic self-sufficiency; 31:31 will describe a ship moving by divine favor. Assigned role: possession establishes comprehensive authority, self-sufficiency removes need for what is possessed, and praise identifies beneficent rather than extractive exercise of authority. Abductive move (inferred): an owner who lacks need can order possessions for their benefit rather than to repair a deficiency in himself. Reading change: divine possession becomes compatible with giving because it is explicitly non-acquisitive.

2. **The sufficiency that finite resources cannot measure.** Lexical evidence: `غ ن ي B002` is sufficing, availing, and replacing, while `ح م د B003` is the praiseworthy one marked by many good traits. Structural cue: totality in heavens and earth is followed by exclusive emphasis `هُوَ`; 31:27 will imagine all trees and serial seas exhausted while divine words remain. Assigned role: cosmic totality supplies the largest finite comparison, and self-sufficiency exceeds dependence on the whole comparison set. Abductive move (inferred): inexhaustibility of the words is the operational display of a source not depleted by what it owns or gives. Reading change: `ٱلْغَنِىُّ` reads as inexhaustible sufficiency sustaining total possession.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - 31:27 literalized self-sufficiency through finite trees and replenished seas that cannot exhaust divine words. 31:31 then showed comprehensive ownership operating as favor that enables a ship, confirming the non-acquisitive, beneficent reading.

baseline.text: Göklerde ve yerde olanlar Allah'ındır. Allah hiçbir şeye muhtaç değildir, övgüye layıktır.

findings.text: Her şeye sahip oluşun hemen ardından ihtiyaçsızlığın gelmesi, ilahi mülkiyeti eksikliği gidermek için toplayan değil, yarar sağlayabilen bir egemenlik olarak gösterir.
Üst ve alt alanların tümü Allah'a ait olduğundan, O bu alanın hiçbir parçasına bağımlı değildir; buna karşılık alanın her parçasını yeterli kılabilir.
Allah'ın övgüye layık oluşu insanların övgüsüyle kurulmaz; tanınmayı beklemeden var olan ve bulunup görülebilen bir niteliktir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel adı Yaratıcıya özgü bir ad olarak tanımlar ve onu tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel adla köken bakımından ilişkilendirir. Aynı adın doğrudan seslenmede, yakarmada, ant bildiriminde ve parçaları düşürülmüş kalıplarda kullanıldığı birlikte gösterilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi adı bir şeyi tanıtan gösterge olarak tanımlar; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve aynı adı ya da niteliği hak eden denklik anlamlarını açıkça bağlar. Adın anılmayı yükselttiğine ilişkin açıklama anlamın tarihsel gerekçesi olarak tutulur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dilsel adlandırma ve adla kurulan denklikle sınırlıdır; gök ya da fiziksel yükselme anlamı yalnız açıklayıcı köken bağıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi tanıtan ad, bu adı verme veya edinme ve başka biriyle aynı adı taşıma ilişkisidir. Ayrıca aynı adı ya da niteliği hak edecek ölçüde denk olmayı anlatır; kaynaklar adlandırmayı anılmayı yükseltme düşüncesiyle açıklar.

facets.statement: Ad, bir varlığı tanıtan ve ondan söz etmeyi sağlayan söz veya anlamdır.
Birine ad verilir veya kişi kendisi için bir ad edinir ve o adla çağrılır.
İki kişi aynı adı taşıdığında birbirinin adaşı olur.
Bir kişi, aynı adı veya niteliği hak edecek ölçüde başkasının dengi sayılır.
Kaynaklar adın kökenini, adı verilen şeyin anılmasını yükseltmesi ve onu belirgin kılmasıyla açıklar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar adı bir varlığı tanıtan unsur sayar; ad verme, ad edinme, aynı adı taşıma ve ada ya da niteliğe layık denklik anlamlarını birleştirir. Adın anılmayı yükselttiği yönündeki köken açıklamasını da paylaşır.

Bu amaçla araziye çıkan kişiler avcı adıyla anılır.
Av hayvanını bulup avlamak üzere arama eylemi aynı alana bağlıdır.
Avcının sıcak zeminde hayvan beklerken ayağını korumak için giydiği çorap adlandırılır.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın üstün gelmek için birbiriyle yarışması, övünerek boy ölçüşmesi veya birbirine karşı koymasıdır. Bir kimseyle hiç kimsenin yarışamaması, onun bu karşılaştırmada erişilemez üstünlüğünü bildirir.

facets.statement: İki veya daha çok taraf üstün gelmek için karşılıklı olarak yarışır.
Taraflar sahip oldukları üstünlüklerle övünerek birbirleriyle boy ölçüşür.
Taraflardan biri ötekine karşı koyar, onunla aynı düzeye gelmeye veya onu geçmeye çalışır.
Kimsenin bir kişiyle yarışamaması, o kişinin erişilemez ölçüde üstün olduğunu bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi anlamı insanlar arasında yayılan ses ya da ünle sınırlar ve bunun yalnız iyi yönde olduğunu açıkça belirtir. Geçici dal tanımı yayılma, toplumsal alan ve olumlu değer koşullarını eksiksiz korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız insanlar arasında yayılan iyi ünü kapsar; kötü ün, her türlü ses veya dilsel ad bu sınıra girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, başka bir söz yapısından anlam taşımadan yalnız dalın insanlar arasında yayılan iyi ün çekirdeğini verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi hakkında insanlar arasında yayılan ve yalnız iyi yönde olan ün veya sözdür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi ya da hayvanı tanınmasını sağlayacak görünür bir izle işaretleme eylemini, bu eylemin bıraktığı izi ve işaretlemede kullanılan kızgın aracı birlikte verir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, her türlü soyut belirtiyi değil; yakma, kulak kesme veya çentikleme gibi yollarla bırakılan tanıtıcı fiziksel izi kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, ortak fiziksel işaretleme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; zırhın alt bölümündeki süslemeyi anlatan özel tamlama yalnızca kendi sözlüksel karşılığında korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi ya da hayvanı, tanınmasını veya ayırt edilmesini sağlayan kalıcı ve görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturacak biçimde işaretlemektir; iz yakma, kulak kesme ya da çentikleme yoluyla bırakılabilir. Anlam alanı, oluşan işareti ve özellikle hayvanı işaretlemeye yarayan kızgın aracı da kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesne veya hayvan üzerinde onu tanıtmaya ve başkalarından ayırmaya yarayan görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturulur.
İşaret, kızgın araçla yakılarak, kulağın bir bölümü kesilerek veya çentik açılarak bırakılabilir.
Eylemin sonucunda kalan tanıtıcı iz de aynı anlam alanında adlandırılır.
Özellikle hayvanlara bu izi koymak için kullanılan kızgın işaretleme aracı da bu dala bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatımda temel ilişki, tanınacak şey üzerinde kasıtlı ve kalıcı bir iz oluşturma ilişkisidir. Yakma, kulak kesme ve çentikleme bu işlemin yollarıdır; sonuçtaki iz ile onu koyan kızgın araç da anlam alanına dahildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişide görülen belirtiyi okuyarak iyilik, kötülük veya genel durum hakkında sonuç çıkarma eylemini açıkça anlatır. Dal çerçevesindeki bakma, belirti ve çıkarım ilişkisi bu anlamı doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Burada belirtiyi yalnızca görmek yetmez; görünür izden kişinin niteliği veya durumu hakkında çıkarım yapılması gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kişideki belirtiyi yorumlama çekirdeğini verir; iyilik veya kötülükle kurulan özel yapılar bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişide görülen belirti veya izlere dikkatle bakarak onun iyiliği, kötülüğü, niteliği ya da durumu hakkında sezgisel bir sonuca varmaktır. Anlam, belirtinin kendisinden çok onu okuyup görünmeyen bir niteliği çıkarma eylemine dayanır.

facets.statement: Kişide görülen bir belirti, görünmeyen bir nitelik veya durumun göstergesi olarak okunur.
Gözlemden hareketle sezgisel bir değerlendirme ve çıkarım yapılır.
Çıkarılan nitelik iyilik de kötülük de olabilir; anlam yalnızca olumlu bir yargıyla sınırlı değildir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, kişideki görünür bir izin onun iyiliğine, kötülüğüne veya durumuna işaret ettiğini fark etmek ve bu işaretten sezgisel bir sonuç çıkarmaktır. Bakan kişi, belirtiyi anlam taşıyan bir gösterge olarak değerlendirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişideki görünür işaretten onun görünmeyen niteliği hakkında çıkarım yapma çekirdeğinin tamamında kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Belirtiyi gözlemleme, onu gösterge sayma ve kişilik ya da durum hakkında sonuç çıkarma aşamalarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Görünür belirtilerin okunması ve bunlardan bir kişinin durumu hakkında sonuç çıkarılması vurgulandığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Gözlenen belirtileri anlamlı göstergeler olarak yorumlama ve sonuç çıkarma sürecini korur.
error_profile.adds: Tek başına kullanıldığında kişi dışındaki nesne ve olaylardan yapılan çıkarımları da kapsayabilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişideki belirtilerden onun iyiliği, kötülüğü veya genel niteliği hakkında hızlı bir yargıya varıldığında doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Açıkça söylenmeyen bir niteliğe dolaylı yoldan ulaşma sonucunu korur.
error_profile.adds: Görünür bir belirtiye dayanmayan içgüdüsel tahminleri de kapsayabilir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir kimsede iyilik ya da kötülük belirtisi görüp niteliğini sezmek
duruma işaret eden belirtileri okuyup sonuç çıkaranlar
üzerinde iyilik ya da kötülük belirtisi bulunan

error_profile.preserves: Kesin olmayan bir sonuca varma yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Herhangi bir görünür belirtiye veya kişiye dayanmayan bütün kestirimleri kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Genel olasılık hesabı ve gelecek öngörüsü anlamlarıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişide iyiliğin yanı sıra kötülük veya başka bir durum belirtisini okuyup çıkarım yapmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir kişide görülen belirtilerden onun iyiliği hakkında sezgisel sonuç çıkarılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal olumlu niteliği sezmekle sınırlıdır; odak dal ise olumlu veya olumsuz işaretleri okuyabilen daha geniş, fakat yine kişiye bağlı bir çıkarım alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Görünür belirtiden kişinin karakteri veya durumu hakkında sezgisel çıkarım yapmayı merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tanıma, karşılıklı tanışma, bir şeyi bildirme ve haber araştırma gibi geniş bilgi edinme işlemlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir iz veya gösterge, kişi ya da şey hakkında bilgi edinmeye yardım eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, belirtinin yorumlanmasıyla görünmeyen niteliğe ulaşır; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise daha genel tanıma ve bilinir kılma işlemleridir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirtiyi okuyanın kişilik veya durum hakkında sezgisel yargıya varmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yola yöneltme dahil olmak üzere bir şeyi bildiren her türlü göstergeyi ve gösterme ilişkisini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisinde de görünür bir belirti, doğrudan görünmeyen başka bir şeye ulaşmayı sağlar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal psikolojik bir okuma ve çıkarım eylemidir; komşu dal ise göstergenin bilgi verme işlevini genel olarak adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; olumlu nitelik sezme, izden tanıma ve genel gösterge ilişkileri okurun karıştırabileceği üç ayrı sınırı gösterdiği için seçildi.
